title: Harborview Pension Fund: expense ratio follow-up (a call to the phone line)
shows: A short inbound call used to capture the phone-line screenshots (tools/capture_phone.py).

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Aisha, it's Dana Whitfield at Harborview Pension Fund. I'm calling about the Contoso Equity Income Fund.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Hi Dana, thanks for calling. What would you like to know about the fund?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Could you send me the expense ratio comparison by Monday? Our committee meets next week.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Of course. I'll email the expense ratio comparison to you by Monday, and I'll set up a review call for next week.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That works for me. Thank you, Aisha.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: My pleasure, Dana. Have a good afternoon.
